events.verdict: Edwards (MIN) establishes positive frontcourt position and is the first player to touch the ball in the backcourt without the ball being deflected by Holiday (POR).
DiVincenzo (MIN) deflects the ball away from Henderson (POR).
DiVincenzo (MIN) is moving alongside Henderson's (POR) path as they come together at the same spot.
Grant (POR) establishes himself in DiVincenzo's (MIN) path prior to the contact.
Gobert (MIN) firms up over his left leg in Camara's (POR) path prior to the contact.
Clingan (POR) establishes himself in Randle's (MIN) path prior to the contact.
Gobert (MIN) initiates contact with Grant's (POR) arm and affects his shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) briefly grasps Clingan's (POR) arm as they pursue the rebound.
Edwards (MIN) legally contests Holiday's (POR) jump shot attempt.
DiVincenzo (MIN) and Henderson (POR) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
DiVincenzo (MIN) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Trail Blazers.
Edwards (MIN) legally contests Krejci's (POR) jump shot attempt.
Krejci (POR) is moving alongside Edwards' (MIN) path as he defends the drive.
Krejci (POR) initiates contact with Edwards' (MIN) arm after he gathers the ball, and the contact affects his shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) initiates contact with Grant (POR) that affects his SQBR.
Camara (POR) commits a take foul on DiVincenzo (MIN).
Henderson (POR) initiates contact with Edwards' (MIN) arm as he is passing the ball.
Reid (MIN) legally contests Camara's (POR) jump shot attempt.
Holiday (POR) commits a take foul on Edwards (MIN).

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (defensive goaltending) is confirmed.  Camara (POR) blocks the shot attempt after the ball makes contact with the backboard and has a chance to score.
